8.3.3.19 Dem_ResetEventStatus
[SWS_Dem_00185] Definition of API function Dem_ResetEventStatus ⌈
Service Name
Dem_ResetEventStatus
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dem_ResetEventStatus (
Dem_EventIdType EventId
)
Service ID [hex]
0x05
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different EventIds. Non reentrant for the same EventId.
Parameters (in)
EventId
Identification of an event by assigned EventId.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Request to reset the event status was successful accepted.
E_NOT_OK: Request to reset the event status failed or is not
allowed, because the event is already tested in this operation
cycle.
Description
Resets the event failed status. This API can only be used through the RTE and therefore no
declaration is exported via Dem.h.
Available via
Dem.h
⌋
